'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2025 Sumy airstrike]]
****During [[Palm Sunday]], two [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[9K720 Iskander|Iskander-M]] [[ballistic missile]]s carrying [[cluster munition]]s strike the centre of [[Sumy]], [[Ukraine]], killing at least 35 people and wounding 117 others. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/russian-missile-strike-ukraines-sumy-kills-mayor/story?id=120759230 (ABC News)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cd02zgrd3nnt (BBC News)]
****The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Defence Ministry]] says the strike targeted a [[military]] gathering in the city. Artem Semenikhin, the mayor of [[Konotop]], Sumy, says regional Governor [[Volodymyr Artyukh]] planned an awards ceremony for the [[117th Territorial Defense Brigade]] in Sumy on the same day. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-attack-sumy-trump-c798e420e87f1ef25af4f01f80128aa6 (AP)] [https://kyivindependent.com/sumy-governor-organized-military-award-ceremony-on-day-of-russian-mass-attack-official-claims/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Israel]] destroys part of the last fully functional hospital in [[Gaza City]], the [[Al-Ahli Arab Hospital|Al-Ahli Arab Baptist Hospital]], which is managed by the [[Episcopal Church in Jerusalem and the Middle East|Episcopal Church in Jerusalem]]. No direct casualties are reported, but one child is killed due to interrupted medical care. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjr7l123zy5o (BBC News)] [https://pchrgaza.org/israel-bombs-gazas-baptist-hospital-putting-it-out-of-service-and-leaving-nearly-one-million-palestinians-with-no-lifesaving-healthcare-services (PCHR Gaza)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**Eight people are killed and a dozen others are injured after a [[Improvised explosive device|roadside bomb]] suspected to be planted by [[Islamic extremism|Islamic extremists]] hits a [[bus]] on the Damboa-Maiduguri highway in [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/10a769e94ab3c0b475e09f20ccd0742c (AP)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Expo 2025]]
**The opening ceremony for the 2025 World Expo is held in [[Osaka]], [[Japan]], which includes pavilions for 160 countries. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2025/04/13/japan/osaka-world-expo-opening-day/ (‘’Japan Times’’)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Five people are killed and twelve others are injured in a fire at a [[hostel]] in [[Pszów]], [[Silesian Voivodeship]], [[Poland]]. [https://tvn24.pl/polska/pszow-pozar-hotelu-piec-osob-nie-zyje-st8409121 (TVN24)]
*Six people are injured, including two critically, and twenty-four homes are damaged after a two-story house explodes in [[Austin, Texas|Austin]], [[Texas]], United States. [https://www.statesman.com/story/news/local/2025/04/13/house-explodes-in-northwest-austin-mc-neil-road-us-183-police-say/83071996007/ (''Austin American-Statesman'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Pennsylvania Governor's Residence fire]]
**The [[Pennsylvania]] [[Pennsylvania Governor's Residence|Governor's Residence]] is targeted in an [[arson]] attack. [[Governor of Pennsylvania|Governor]] [[Josh Shapiro]] and his family are evacuated and the fire was extinguished. A suspect was later arrested and charged with [[attempted murder]], [[terrorism]], aggravated arson and [[aggravated assault]] against an enumerated person. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/gov-josh-shapiro-residence-arson-investigation-rcna201044 (NBC News)] [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/police-someone-set-fire-to-pennsylvania-governors-residence-no-one-was-injured/ (CTV News)]
*[[Security incidents involving Donald Trump]]
**An [[Americans|American]] teen follower of the [[Order of Nine Angles]] previously charged with killing his parents is also accused of plotting to [[assassinate]] [[U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/teen-charged-killing-parents-planned-assassinate-trump-rcna201054 (NBC News)]
*At least 46 people are injured and treated at the scene and one person is hospitalized when a [[tear gas]] canister leaks at [[Miniatur Wunderland]] in [[Hamburg]], [[Germany]]. The perpetrator behind the leak is unidentified. [https://www.dw.com/en/tear-gas-attack-at-hamburgs-miniatur-wunderland-injures-46/a-72230286 (DW)]
*Two people are killed and nine others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a park in [[Conway, Arkansas|Conway]], [[Arkansas]], United States. [https://apnews.com/article/conway-park-shooting-two-dead-74f51909bea6dfe390fd96f4484a42d5 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Gabonese presidential election]]
**[[Gabon]]ese [[Committee for the Transition and Restoration of Institutions|military leader]] [[Brice Oligui Nguema]] wins the presidential election with more than 90% of the vote as an [[independent politician]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp31kxg35dro (BBC News)]
*[[2025 Ecuadorian general election]]
**Incumbent [[Ecuador]]ian [[president of Ecuador|president]] [[Daniel Noboa]] wins re-election for a full term in a rematch against [[Citizen Revolution Movement]] candidate and former [[National Assembly (Ecuador)|assemblywoman]] [[Luisa González]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/04/13/americas/ecuador-vote-noboa-gonzalez-latam-intl/index.html (CNN)]
